showcase.title: A structured progression from pain to movement confidence.
showcase.description: Rehabilitation is neither guesswork nor a passive quick fix. It is an intentional sequence of shared understanding, objective assessment, and progressive reconditioning.
showcase.trajectoryDescription: Every phase is engineered to deconstruct ambiguity, building predictable and resilient kinetic capacity.

01.title: Understand · Listening to Pain Context
01.short: We begin not with silent testing, but with deliberate dialogue regarding what you feel and face daily.
01.action: In-depth clinical dialogue examining pain history, triggers, movement apprehension, and personal recovery goals.
01.takeaway: You leave knowing your condition has been heard with depth, empathy, and specificity.
01.mindset: From: Confusion & Anxiety ← To: Reassurance & Clarity

02.title: Assess · Evaluating the Kinetic Chain
02.short: Knee or shoulder pain frequently stems from a biomechanical restriction elsewhere along the chain.
02.action: Functional kinematic evaluation testing joint ranges, muscular balance, neural control, and postural patterns.
02.takeaway: A transparent biomechanical breakdown showing the real root cause of your discomfort.
02.mindset: From: Focusing only on the symptom ← To: Seeing the complete kinetic picture

03.title: Plan · Designing Your Individual Care Path
03.short: No one-size-fits-all templates; we establish a progression that aligns with your real life and stamina.
03.action: Structured 1-on-1 sessions, concise micro-movement drills for home/desk, and customized load pacing.
03.takeaway: A realistic milestone timeline and transparent expectations for sustainable recovery.
03.mindset: From: Scattered quick fixes ← To: A purposeful, structured roadmap

04.title: Progress · Restoring Movement & Confidence
04.short: The ultimate aim is not clinic dependency, but empowering you to move with resilience and trust.
04.action: Objective metric re-testing, progressive load tolerance, and functional simulation of your sport or work.
04.takeaway: Unrestricted return to active life and sports with lifelong self-care literacy.
04.mindset: From: Kinesiophobia & Fear of Re-injury ← To: Movement Confidence & Autonomy
